symptoms_1.text: Another prisoner coughing. Did the transfer orders say where they go?

symptoms_2.text: Only the ward number. Nobody tells us what happens after that.

symptoms_3.text: Keep your voice down. I'll check the passage. You watch the stairs.

password_1.text: I need to log into this terminal. What was the password again?

password_2.text: Root. All lowercase. R, O, O, T. Same as last shift.

password_3.text: Right. Once you're in, you can disable both checkpoint cameras.

password_4.text: I'll watch the far passage. Don't leave the terminal open.

ward_1.text: They sealed the ward again. Even our keys won't open that gate.

ward_2.text: Read the experiment records first. Then use the manual release.

ward_3.text: Fine. I'm turning back to the passage. I don't like standing here.

body_0.text: No... I know him. We were on shift together. Someone's here!

body_1.text: No... I know him. We were on shift together. Someone's here!

body_2.text: No... I know him. We were on shift together. Someone's here!

treason_1.text: The one from Cell 07. They say he opened a door he shouldn't have.

treason_2.text: I heard he refused an order. Same thing, up here.

branch_missing_0.text: Someone let him out. Somebody on our shift.

branch_missing_1.text: Check the lockers again. He can't just vanish.

branch_hunted_0.text: He killed Rowan. Rowan had a daughter.

branch_hunted_1.text: Stay in pairs. Don't let him get close.

niro_2833dd4b30.text:
Come back. Let me take you out of here.
We used to trust each other.

niro_628d72a58b.text:
Miro. It's Niro. You are my brother.
You kept order; I kept the ward. I thought we were helping people.

niro_a05a866c01.text:
I became a doctor to help people. These wards are all I know.
If the seals fail, prisoners and Keepers both get sick.

niro_59ba31d404.text:
They told me there was no other way. I need to believe
we can still make this work.

niro_6c60638bd7.text: Put it down, Miro. You were never supposed to wake up this far down.

niro_367b7cef9e.text:
You were never sick. Exposure after exposure, nothing.
You are immune, Miro. You always were.

niro_99d8018a0e.text:
The tower made the sickness. They called it progress.
When it got out, they told me you were our only chance.

niro_f037a8ec67.text:
I kept you alive. I thought if I understood why, I could save everyone.
They said you'd destroy the cure if you got out. I believed them.

niro_700e506fe0.text: I believed keeping you here was love.

niro_5b185efc56.text:
Stay. Help me finish it. If all of this was for nothing...
I do not know who I have been.

niro_737778b375.text:
The sick are still real. Whatever the tower did...
do not forget them.

niro_a8901c4c6e.text:
I wanted a life where I could keep you safe.
They gave me a title, and I mistook it for a choice.

niro_a066a9621c.text:
(He looks at the lab, not at Miro.)
Someone has to stay with them. Go.

niro_e0ae8640eb.text:
Every time you raise that thing, they write it down.
Dangerous. Unstable. You're proving them right.

niro_b711c20d25.text:
This floor holds everything up. Me included.
Stop, Miro.

niro_4e9c139eb2.text: You don't understand what's down there.

niro_fb40ed3dde.text: Then come to the bottom. See what you're breaking.

niro_99f4f44da6.text: Can you hear me? Good. I hate this thing too. It makes me sound like them.

niro_9f2a0012ca.text: You're running in circles, Miro. I drew the circles.

niro_6cdd67e828.text: Every Keeper you put to sleep is a report I write tonight. In my handwriting.

niro_cb07e495f3.text: They're not hunting you. They're collecting you. There's a difference. I made sure of it.

niro_98c21d71f0.text: Slow down. Your heart rate's on my screen. You'll tear something I stitched.

niro_f19602b658.text: Nobody leaves this tower, Miro. Not the sick. Not the Keepers. Not me.

niro_24e11665ef.text: Down is the wrong way. Down is where I keep the truth. Come and look, then.

niro_529c309714.text: Nobody even knows your face anymore. Come home before they do.

niro_68ca6d623e.text: You walked through my whole tower and nobody saw you. You could have just left.

niro_b492b2b223.text: They're calling you a monster. Stop proving them right.

niro_aafe65c4a0.text: How many, Miro? How many before you're what they said?

niro_3bf8d928f0.text: I can hear the alarms from here. Please stop.

niro_925f70ceb1.text: You used to. Stay there. Let me help you.

niro_342a4156c2.text:
Miro. Please. Don't go any lower.
You took his life. Was that necessary?

niro_7d3065558e.text:
Miro. Please. Don't go any lower.
You got past him without killing. There is still time to stop.

pa_ab939b6eb9.text: Prisoner M-07 unaccounted for. Search your sections.

pa_e6a4edf388.text: Prisoner M-07 is armed and has killed Keepers. Lethal force authorised.

pa_d5ab4b39ec.text: Prisoner M-07 is the bomber. All units...
